purpose: This module runs a calibration fixture chain from a committed manifest, providing a command-line entry point and managing path setup for dependency modules. It validates fixtures, runs each one through a scoring pipeline, and optionally writes metrics to CSV files, returning an exit code based on failure rates.

public_api.name: FixtureRunner
public_api.role: Type alias for a callable that executes a fixture and returns an object to be flattened into metrics.

public_api.name: build_parser
public_api.role: Creates and returns an argparse.ArgumentParser configured to accept --fixtures (selected fixture names), --out (output directory for CSV files), and --no-replay-mask flags.

public_api.name: run_manifest
public_api.role: Runs selected fixtures from a registry, collects scores, catches and logs per-fixture failures, optionally writes CSV metrics, and returns exit code 0 (fewer than half failed) or 3 (half or more failed).

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: Entry point that parses command-line arguments and delegates to run_manifest; called by the if __name__ == '__main__' guard to produce process exit code.
